Published Dec 29, 2022, 10:00 AM EST
Rudransh Bundela lives in Mumbai and has done his bachelors in filmmaking from Bond University, Australia. He then went on to work at Ogilvy and Mather has been in love with writing ever since.
The last day of school and the first day of summer vacation spells paradise. Displaying all the fundamental signs of its lineage of high school films, _Dazed and Confused_ works as an elaborate summary of the angst and trite that every student goes through as a rite of passage. The film is directed by Richard Linklater, a director whose entire filmography is largely synonymous with youth and love. In terms of the plot, the story revolves around a group of high schoolers during the last day of school. Linklater brilliantly documents the many factions of students without overly typecasting them. There are the nerds, the jocks, the stoners, and the juniors. _Dazed and Confused_deals with themes of love, drugs, and sexuality with a degree of reality and rawness. An appropriate approach to the transition from youth to maturity. Here’s a look at where the cast is today.

## Matthew McConaughey
Paramount Pictures
“Alright, alright, alright” As soon as you hear these words, **Matthew McConaughey**’s teenage face pops up in memory, hand on the steering wheel, joint in hand. In an interview, the now Oscar award-winning star explained these three words were the first words he ever uttered on film. Cut to two decades later, Matthew McConaughey firmly holds the position of one of the most versatile, revered, and impactful actors of the current generation, having won an Academy Award for his portrayal of Ron, a hard-boiled, rodeo cowboy who’s been diagnosed with AIDS in _Dallas Buyers Club._ Apart from that, McConaughey’s has gone on to feature in blockbuster films such as _Interstellar, Wolf of Wall Street, The Gentlemen,_and a major role in HBO’s hit series, _True Detective._

## Ben Affleck
Ben Affleck as Batman in Justice League
Warner Bros.
_Dazed and Confused_ launched another megastar in the form of _**Ben Affleck**._ The film showed Affleck playing the part of a brain-dead jock, Fred O’Bannion responsible for terrorizing the juniors. Currently, Affleck is as big a name as any in the power circles of Hollywood and has been seen in pathbreaking projects such as _Gone Girl_ and _Argo_,while also briefly playing the coveted role of Bruce Wayne, AKA Batman, in Zack Snyder’s epic _Batman Vs Superman._ For his efforts, Affleck has received an Academy Award as a writer for _Good Will Hunting_ and as a Director for Argo.

## Jason London
Buena Vista Pictures Distribution
**Jason London** is best known for his portrayal of Randall ‘Pink’ Floyd in _Dazed and Confused._ Since then, London has gone on to act in films such as _The Rage: Carrie 2, and Out Cold_,along with his miniseries called _Jason and the Argonauts._ Additionally, the actor has more than 130 acting credits on IMDB, along with a special appearance in Aerosmith’s video for "Amazing"_._

## Milla Jovovich
Milla Jovovich as Alice in Resident Evil
Constantin Film Verleih / Pathé Distribution
After playing the cute Michelle Burroughs in _Dazed and Confused_, **Milla Jovovich** has gone on a killing spree of monsters in the _Resident Evil_ film series. A stark contrast from the shy teenager to the alpha woman, thereby helping Jovovich carve out a certain niche in the action/horror genre. Along with her staple _Resident Evil films,_ the Ukrainian-born actress has also featured in films such as _Zoolander, Hellboy, and The Fifth Element._

## Wiley Wiggins
Gramercy Pictures
Post _Dazed and Confused’s_ celebratory buzz, **Wiley Wiggins** has had a somewhat unusual career. The then-teenage star, has gone on to work as a game designer and producer, and also has taken up the role of an editor. The multi-talented artist also has acting credits on films such as _Walking Life, Boys_,and _Computer Chess._

## Adam Goldberg
Paramount Pictures
**Adam Goldberg** began his acting career with _Mr. Saturday Night,_ before he went on to play Mike Newhouse in _Dazed and Confused,_ which then set him up for an opportunity that would put him on the map for the world to see. Goldberg landed the role of Mellish, a loudmouth of an infantryman in Steven Spielberg’s war epic, _Saving Private Ryan._ Since then, Goldberg has gone on to do several supporting roles in films such as _A Beautiful Mind, Deja Vu_,and _Frankenstein._ The actor has also worked on several TV shows, most notably on HBO’s _Entourage._

## Nicky Katt
Warner Bros.
Having risen to fame due to his rough and cruel antics in _Dazed and Confused,_**Nicky Katt** went on to star as a white supremacist, and child abuser in _A Time to Kill._ The actor collaborated again with Richard Linklater on _SubUrbia,_ where he played the role of Tim, a drunk teenager, with a knack for shooting off his mouth. With more than 70 acting credits in a career spanning more than four decades, Nicky Katt’s latest project sees him portray the role of Cyril on the TV series, _Casual._

## Cole Hauser
Cole Hauser as Rip Wheeler in Yellowstone
Paramount Network
Another _Dazed and Confused_ bully on the list is Benny O'Donnell. A nightmare on-screen, **Cole Hauser** along with fellow bullies provided a much-needed balance on-screen in contrast to the meek and docile nerds. Since then, Hauser has worked on revolutionary films such as _Good Will Hunting, 2 Fast 2 Furious_,and the Emmy-nominated show, _Yellowstone._

Title: Where Is the 'Dazed and Confused' Cast Now? See the Stars 32 Years After the Movie Premiered

### NEED TO KNOW
*   _Dazed and Confused_ premiered over three decades ago on Sept. 24, 1993  
*   The coming-of-age comedy starred Ben Affleck, Matthew McConaughey and Renée Zellweger in the early days of their careers  
*   The film has since become a cult classic, and many of the stars have continued acting in Hollywood
Much of the _Dazed and Confused_ cast was just getting started in Hollywood when the film premiered over three decades ago.
The coming-of-age comedy premiered in theaters on Sept. 24, 1993, and while it wasn't a huge success then, it has since become a cult classic. It followed a group of rowdy teenagers in Austin, Texas, as they celebrate the last day of high school in 1976, and starred several now-famous actors — including Matthew McConaughey, Ben Affleck, Renée Zellweger and Milla Jovovich — who have gone on to big things in the years since.
McConaughey, who starred as David Wooderson, has taken on several other iconic roles (including one that led him to win an Oscar!), but in an April 2024 conversation with PEOPLE, he revealed that his iconic catchphrase from _Dazed and Confused_ — "Alright, alright, alright" — has stuck with him all these years later.
"I had no idea that that line would precede me for the rest of my life. People ask me all the time, 'Are you tired of that preceding you?' And I'm like, 'Hell, no,' " he said, adding that the line was "never written," and instead improvised.
In honor of the film's 32nd anniversary, here's where the cast of _Dazed and Confused_ is today.
01 of 11

## Ben Affleck as Fred O'Bannion
Ben Affleck as Fred O'Bannion in 'Dazed and Confused' ; Ben Affleck attends the Los Angeles Premiere of Amazon MGM Studios 'The Accountant 2' at TCL Chinese Theatre on April 16, 2025, in Hollywood, Calif.  
Universal; Kevin Winter/Getty
Affleck tackled the role of angry soon-to-be super-senior Fred O'Bannion, who took pleasure in paddling freshmen during Lee High School's annual hazing ritual.
You're probably already well aware of what Affleck has been up to since _Dazed and Confused_. He's an in-demand actor and director, a two-time Oscar winner — one for Best Original Screenplay for _Good Will Hunting_ (1997) and his second for Best Picture for _Argo_ (2012) — a father of three with ex Jennifer Garner and was married to Jennifer Lopez from 2022 to 2024 after a first go at love 20 years prior.
Amidst all that, Affleck has also starred in more than a dozen extremely successful movies, such as _Shakespeare in Love_ (1998), _Armageddon_ (1998), _Pearl Harbor_ (2001), _The Sum of All Fears_ (2002), _Daredevil_ (2003), _Gone Girl_ (2014), _Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice_ (2016), _The Accountant_ (2016), _Justice League_ (2017), _The Last Duel_ (2021) and _The Accountant 2_ (2025). His directing credits include Gone Baby Gone (2007), _The Town_ (2010), _Argo_ (2012), _Live by Night_ (2016) and _Air_ (2023).
02 of 11

## Joey Lauren Adams as Simone Kerr
Joey Lauren Adams as Simone Kerr in 'Dazed and Confused' ; Joey Lauren Adams attends the 30th Anniversary screening of 'Dazed And Confused' on Sept. 28, 2024.  
Universal; Amy E. Price/Getty
Joey Lauren Adams played Simone Kerr, the girlfriend of Lee High School's star football player.
Adams reunited with Affleck for 1997's _Chasing Amy_, joked with Adam Sandler in 1999's _Big Daddy_, played Jennifer Aniston's best pal in 2006's _The Break-Up_ and has also dabbled in writing and directing with the 2006 film _Come Early Morning_. She reprised her _Chasing Amy_ role in _Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back_ (2001) and _Jay and Silent Bob Reboot_ (2019). On television, Adams had a recurring role on _United States of Tara_ and starred opposite Billy Ray Cyrus on _Still the King._
In 2014, Adams married cinematographer Brian Vilim.
03 of 11

## Matthew McConaughey as David Wooderson
Matthew McConaughey as David Wooderson in 'Dazed and Confused' ; Matthew McConaughey of 'The Lost Bus' at the Variety Studio during the Toronto International Film Festival held at The St. Regis Toronto on Sept. 6, 2025 in Toronto.  
Universal; Michelle Quance/Variety via Getty
McConaughey played David Wooderson, an older guy who hadn't quite moved on from high school or high school girls, memorably saying, "I get older, they stay the same age."
_Dazed and Confused_ also features the origin of McConaughey's iconic catchphrase, "Alright, alright, alright."
Since starring in _Dazed and Confused_, the former PEOPLE Sexiest Man Alive has found blockbuster success in dramas, rom-coms and comedies, including _Contact_ (1997), _Amistad_ (1997), _U-571_ (2000), _The Wedding Planner_ (2001), _How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days_ (2003) and _Failure to Launch_ (2006).
Beginning with 2011's _The Lincoln Lawyer_, McConaughey had a remarkable streak of critically-acclaimed films, including 2011's _Bernie_ (which reunited him with _Dazed and Confused_ director Richard Linklater), 2011's _Killer Joe_, 2012's _Mud_, 2012's _Magic Mike_ and 2013's Dallas Buyers Club, for which he won the Academy Award for Best Actor.
He has since appeared in films like _The Wolf of Wall Street_ (2013), _Interstellar_ (2014) and _The Gentlemen_ (2019). He also received rave reviews for his role in the first season of HBO's _True Detective_.
Together, McConaughey and his wife Camila share three children: Levi, Vida and Livingston.
04 of 11

## Milla Jovovich as Michelle Burroughs
Milla Jovovich as Michelle Burroughs in 'Dazed and Confused' ; Milla Jovovich attends amfAR Gala Cannes 2022 at Hotel du Cap-Eden-Roc on May 26, 2022, in Cap d'Antibes, France.  
Universal; Samir Hussein/WireImage
Ukrainian model-actress Jovovich had a small role in the film as hippie Michelle Burroughs. But off-screen was another story: At just 16, she married _Dazed and Confused_ costar and on-screen beau Shawn Andrews, then 21, only to have her mom annul the marriage a few months later.
Then, her career picked up from there. After winning over audiences in _The Fifth Element_ (1997) and _Zoolander_ (2001), Jovovich starred in the action film _Resident Evil_ (2002), which was followed by five sequels.
She married _Resident Evil_ director Paul W. S. Anderson in 2009 and has appeared in many of his films, including _The Three Musketeers_ (2011), _Monster Hunter_ (2020) and _In the Lost Lands_ (2025).
Jovovich and Anderson have welcomed three children.

## The Cast
### Where are they now
**Jason London (Pink)** – (not to be confused with his twin brother, Jeremy… or Brendan Fraser for that matter) still acting, but honestly I didn’t recognize anything since one episode of scandal in 2012. Biggest credit since Dazed… maybe a trio of Aerosmith videos? Did one episode of a lot of shows.
**Joey Lauren Adams (Simone)** – went on to start in lots of Kevin James movies and Big Daddy. Still acting.
**Wiley Wiggins (Mitch)** – No longer acting. Did one other Richard Linklater Waking Life in 2000. He’s now a videogame designer.
**Michelle Burke (Jodi)** – She did Coneheads after Dazed. She married singer-songwriter Scott Thomas in 1995 and they have 3 kids. Took a big break from acting while her kids were young… back at it but not in anything big.
**Anthony Rapp (Tony)** – Got more into theater, and starred in Rent.
**Adam Goldberg (Mike)** – (not that Adam Goldberg) He was in Saving Private Ryan, A Beautiful Mind, and Zodiac. Still acting.
**Marissa Ribisi (Cynthia)** – twin sister of Giovanni Ribisi. She was in True Crime, The Brady Bunch Movie, Pleasantville. married singer Beck in 2004. The “Loser” singer filed for divorce in 2019 and the pair’s split was finalized two years later. The duo share son Cosimo and daughter Tuesday.
**Rory Chocorane (Slater)** – Still acting. Works with Ben Affleck a bit. Empire Records, Argo, Public Enemies, and Black Mass.
**Cole Hauser (Benny)** – Nepo baby. Dad is an actor and mom was from the Warner Bros. family. Stayed close to Ben and was in Good Will Hunting. Small roles in a lot of other big things like White Oleander, the Fast and Furious franchise (Carter), and now he plays Rip Wheeler on Yellowstone.
**Sasha Jenson (Don)** – Was in the Buffy movie. Left acting

## The Cast
### Where are they now
**Nicky Katt (Clint)** – Went on to be in A Time to Kill with McConaughey, Boston Public, and School of Rock (Another Linklater – we’ll come back to when we talk about the soundtrack). Hasn’t really done too much in the last 10 years.
**Chrisse Harnos (Kaye)** – She went on to play Dr. Mark Green’s wife, Jennifer, on ER. left acting in 2003 to pursue a degree in child development
**Christin Hinjosa (Sabrina)** – left acting. Works as a social justice and environmental activist.

The last day of school and the first day of summer vacation spells paradise. Displaying all the fundamental signs of its lineage of high school films, _Dazed and Confused_ works as an elaborate summary of the angst and trite that every student goes through as a rite of passage. The film is directed by Richard Linklater, a director whose entire filmography is largely synonymous with youth and love. In terms of the plot, the story revolves around a group of high schoolers during the last day of school. Linklater brilliantly documents the many factions of students without overly typecasting them. There are the nerds, the jocks, the stoners, and the juniors. _Dazed and Confused_deals with themes of love, drugs, and sexuality with a degree of reality and rawness. An appropriate approach to the transition from youth to maturity. Here’s a look at where the cast is today.

## Matthew McConaughey
Paramount Pictures
“Alright, alright, alright” As soon as you hear these words, **Matthew McConaughey**’s teenage face pops up in memory, hand on the steering wheel, joint in hand. In an interview, the now Oscar award-winning star explained these three words were the first words he ever uttered on film. Cut to two decades later, Matthew McConaughey firmly holds the position of one of the most versatile, revered, and impactful actors of the current generation, having won an Academy Award for his portrayal of Ron, a hard-boiled, rodeo cowboy who’s been diagnosed with AIDS in _Dallas Buyers Club._ Apart from that, McConaughey’s has gone on to feature in blockbuster films such as _Interstellar, Wolf of Wall Street, The Gentlemen,_and a major role in HBO’s hit series, _True Detective._

## Ben Affleck
Ben Affleck as Batman in Justice League
Warner Bros.
_Dazed and Confused_ launched another megastar in the form of _**Ben Affleck**._ The film showed Affleck playing the part of a brain-dead jock, Fred O’Bannion responsible for terrorizing the juniors. Currently, Affleck is as big a name as any in the power circles of Hollywood and has been seen in pathbreaking projects such as _Gone Girl_ and _Argo_,while also briefly playing the coveted role of Bruce Wayne, AKA Batman, in Zack Snyder’s epic _Batman Vs Superman._ For his efforts, Affleck has received an Academy Award as a writer for _Good Will Hunting_ and as a Director for Argo.

### NEED TO KNOW
*   _Dazed and Confused_ premiered over three decades ago on Sept. 24, 1993  
*   The coming-of-age comedy starred Ben Affleck, Matthew McConaughey and Renée Zellweger in the early days of their careers  
*   The film has since become a cult classic, and many of the stars have continued acting in Hollywood
Much of the _Dazed and Confused_ cast was just getting started in Hollywood when the film premiered over three decades ago.
The coming-of-age comedy premiered in theaters on Sept. 24, 1993, and while it wasn't a huge success then, it has since become a cult classic. It followed a group of rowdy teenagers in Austin, Texas, as they celebrate the last day of high school in 1976, and starred several now-famous actors — including Matthew McConaughey, Ben Affleck, Renée Zellweger and Milla Jovovich — who have gone on to big things in the years since.
McConaughey, who starred as David Wooderson, has taken on several other iconic roles (including one that led him to win an Oscar!), but in an April 2024 conversation with PEOPLE, he revealed that his iconic catchphrase from _Dazed and Confused_ — "Alright, alright, alright" — has stuck with him all these years later.
"I had no idea that that line would precede me for the rest of my life. People ask me all the time, 'Are you tired of that preceding you?' And I'm like, 'Hell, no,' " he said, adding that the line was "never written," and instead improvised.
In honor of the film's 32nd anniversary, here's where the cast of _Dazed and Confused_ is today.

Matthew McConaughey as David Wooderson in 'Dazed and Confused' ; Matthew McConaughey of 'The Lost Bus' at the Variety Studio during the Toronto International Film Festival held at The St. Regis Toronto on Sept. 6, 2025 in Toronto.

McConaughey played David Wooderson, an older guy who hadn't quite moved on from high school or high school girls, memorably saying, "I get older, they stay the same age."
_Dazed and Confused_ also features the origin of McConaughey's iconic catchphrase, "Alright, alright, alright."
Since starring in _Dazed and Confused_, the former PEOPLE Sexiest Man Alive has found blockbuster success in dramas, rom-coms and comedies, including _Contact_ (1997), _Amistad_ (1997), _U-571_ (2000), _The Wedding Planner_ (2001), _How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days_ (2003) and _Failure to Launch_ (2006).
Beginning with 2011's _The Lincoln Lawyer_, McConaughey had a remarkable streak of critically-acclaimed films, including 2011's _Bernie_ (which reunited him with _Dazed and Confused_ director Richard Linklater), 2011's _Killer Joe_, 2012's _Mud_, 2012's _Magic Mike_ and 2013's Dallas Buyers Club, for which he won the Academy Award for Best Actor.
He has since appeared in films like _The Wolf of Wall Street_ (2013), _Interstellar_ (2014) and _The Gentlemen_ (2019). He also received rave reviews for his role in the first season of HBO's _True Detective_.
Together, McConaughey and his wife Camila share three children: Levi, Vida and Livingston.

Ukrainian model-actress Jovovich had a small role in the film as hippie Michelle Burroughs. But off-screen was another story: At just 16, she married _Dazed and Confused_ costar and on-screen beau Shawn Andrews, then 21, only to have her mom annul the marriage a few months later.
Then, her career picked up from there. After winning over audiences in _The Fifth Element_ (1997) and _Zoolander_ (2001), Jovovich starred in the action film _Resident Evil_ (2002), which was followed by five sequels.
She married _Resident Evil_ director Paul W. S. Anderson in 2009 and has appeared in many of his films, including _The Three Musketeers_ (2011), _Monster Hunter_ (2020) and _In the Lost Lands_ (2025).
